params.name: Config
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute with the fields added from Fields: { id?, sections?, sidebar?, titleField?, heading?, title?, saveLabel?, editable?, label?, emptyHeading? }. The id selects the record to load (none: a new record). A sidebar card lists field keys.

params.name: Fields
params.doc: The record's fields, typed as PkFieldGroup's: Key, Label, Kind, Get and Set, plus Hint, Help, Required, Options, Span and the rest. In view mode they read as a list; in edit mode the element draws them as a pk-field-group. When, Disabled, ReadOnly, LabelWhen and HelpWhen are read from the record once it is loaded (they are .NET functions of the item and do not follow edits until the next load or save: a round trip per keystroke is not what the page does); for a condition that follows what the user types set the declarative WhenExpr, DisabledExpr, ReadonlyExpr, RequiredExpr, LabelWhenExpr or HelpWhenExpr on the spec: the element evaluates them in the browser against the live values, also across cards (a field in one section can decide a field in another or in the sidebar); a spec Editor is the body of its field in edit mode (it edits the item itself).

params.name: Model
params.doc: The record a new one (Config without an id) starts from and Save receives: set it to an instance to fill. A record with an id is what Load returns.

params.name: ViewFields
params.doc: Value templates by field key: each replaces the text of that field in view mode (the main list and the sidebar cards). A field without one shows its value. The content is yours, so it reads the record from your own state.

params.name: Busy
params.note: The page's work in flight (bind it to PageBase.IsBusy): Edit, Cancel, Save and Delete wait.

params.name: Error
params.note: The page's error text (bind it to PageBase.StatusMessage, or the text DescribeError gives): a notice above the form; null or empty clears it.

params.name: OnAction
params.note: A title-bar action (config.actions entry without an href) was clicked; Key is its key.

params.name: OnDirty
params.note: The unsaved-changes state changed (Dirty): confirm before leaving the page.

params.name: OnSave
params.note: Save resolved and the page is back in view mode (Save already received the values).

params.name: OnDelete
params.note: The Delete button was pressed (Id is the record's id). Setting it shows Delete of an existing record, in view and edit mode; confirm, delete and navigate away in the handler, inside TryBusyAsync on a PageBase page.

params.name: Sections
params.doc: Titled cards of fields in the main column (Heading, Fields: the keys). Fields no section or sidebar card names come first, under Config's heading. In edit mode each card is a field group of the one form.

params.name: Sidebar
params.doc: Cards of fields beside the main column, in place of Config's sidebar. In edit mode they are editable and saved with the rest; a field a sidebar card names is edited there only.

params.name: TitleOf
params.doc: The page title from the loaded record (or the Model of a new one), read on every render, a save included; Config's title is the fallback while it returns nothing.

params.name: IsUserFacing
params.doc: Decides that an exception thrown by Load or Save is written for the person even though it does not implement IPkUserFacingException, as PkRecordEditor.IsUserFacing does: its message then reaches the page (an app whose domain exception base cannot reference PlainKit.Blazor passes ex => ex is AppException). Either the marker or the predicate shows the message; a predicate that throws is logged and counts as false. Any other exception shows a generic line and is logged. It covers the two callbacks the element calls; OnDelete is your own handler (inside TryBusyAsync, DescribeError chooses the text).

params.name: OnCancel
params.note: Cancel was pressed (Id is null for a new record). Setting it shows Cancel on a new record too; an existing record leaves edit mode itself, so navigate away only for a new one.

params.name: Load
params.doc: Loads the record whose id (config.id, the route's param) is given; null shows the 'record not found' state. Its field values are read through Fields.Get. Not called for a new record (no id). Throwing shows the element's error state.

params.name: Save
params.doc: Saves the record: the loaded item (or Model for a new one) with the form's values applied through each field's Set (or SetAsync). Having it shows Edit and Save. Throwing keeps the edits and shows the exception message; returning switches to view mode.

notes: New component: App framework step 7 (issue #353). Load(id) and Save(values) are callback properties (business logic), set from script, so the generated component hands the element a .NET reference (PkCallbackSlot) that calls the Load and Save parameters, as PkSettingsPage does for Save (issue #1000). Blazor already has the same page concept as PkRecordForm (a PkForm with a toolbar, error alert and a PkDetailLayout sidebar, with the state kept by the page or PkRecordEditor, and ActionsInHeader for the sticky title bar); PkRecordPage is the config-driven element, PkRecordForm stays the composable Razor template. ViewFields (field key to a RenderFragment) fills the field-<key> value slots of the view mode (issue 1000); MainBefore, MainAfter and SideAfter fill the main-before, main-after and side-after slots (PkCard sections around the field list or form and after the sidebar cards, issue 1000); Busy and Error are the page-bound surface (PageBase.IsBusy, StatusMessage) and OnDelete shows the Delete button (issue 1000, step 1); a typed Model, Save(TItem) and an edit-mode editor stay open on the issue. Step 2 of issue 1000: PkRecordPage<TItem> is the only record page. Fields (PkFieldSpec<TItem>) and Model replace the JSON config fields, the generator's `recordModel` mapping adds them to Config (PkFieldSpecs.RecordConfig), Load returns the TItem and Save receives it with the form's values applied through each spec's Set.
